description: Saves the agreed gift idea as a plan: the product, what goes on it, the style and any text, and whether the user's own photo is used. Returns a link to the MyImage2Life website, where the user makes the design, sees the proof and price, and orders. Nothing is created or charged by this tool.

idea.description: What goes on the product: subject, composition, colours and mood, in a few rich sentences. For the user's own photo: what to do with it
idea.title: Idea

kind.description: new_design = a design is made from the idea on the website; own_photo = the user uploads their own photo on the website
kind.title: Kind

language.description: Language of the user: nl or en
language.title: Language

recipient.description: Optional: who it is for and the occasion, e.g. 'grandma, 80th birthday'
recipient.title: Recipient

text.description: Optional exact text on the product, e.g. 'Happy birthday Sanne'
text.title: Text
